source_trace.notes: destination_activities rebuilt with is_default_jvto flag from real API (SQL export). db_id = primary key in destination_activities table. JVTO uses one unified Bromo Ticket (160k, no dom/for split). Tumpak Sewu guide corrected to 200k. Medical Checkup + Coffee+Indomie added for Ijen. Malang updated to Santerra/Jodipan/Taman Langit. Coffee & Cocoa and Taman Safari are manual seeds (not in destination_activities DB table).

destination_activities.name: Bromo Ticket
destination_activities.notes: JVTO uses domestic rate for all guests (160k). BRTS National Park entrance fee.

destination_activities.name: Bromo Jeep
destination_activities.notes: 4WD Jeep to crater rim. 1 jeep per 4 pax (rounded up). JVTO contract rate.

destination_activities.name: Bromo Jeep (TWT)
destination_activities.notes: TWT channel higher rate

destination_activities.name: Bromo Jeep (Student Group)
destination_activities.notes: Discounted rate for student group bookings

destination_activities.name: Ijen Ticket
destination_activities.notes: Ijen Crater entrance fee — JVTO uses domestic rate for all guests.

destination_activities.name: Coffee + Indomie
destination_activities.notes: Warm drink and instant noodle snack at Ijen summit area. Standard JVTO inclusion.

destination_activities.name: Local Guide (Ijen)
destination_activities.notes: Mandatory local guide from Paltuding basecamp. 1 per group.

destination_activities.name: Medical Checkup
destination_activities.notes: Health screening at Paltuding basecamp before trek. Per person.

destination_activities.name: Gas Mask
destination_activities.notes: Sulfur gas mask — mandatory for TWT, NOT auto-included for JVTO. Available at Paltuding.

destination_activities.name: Ijen Certificate
destination_activities.notes: Optional souvenir certificate after summit

destination_activities.name: Tumpak Sewu - Ticket
destination_activities.notes: Tumpak Sewu entrance fee. JVTO rate.

destination_activities.name: Tumpak Sewu - Local Guide
destination_activities.notes: Required guide for steep descent trail. 1 per group. Rate is 200k (was incorrectly 150k in previous version).

destination_activities.name: Tumpak Sewu - Lunch
destination_activities.notes: Lunch included at nearby warung after waterfall trek.

destination_activities.name: Tumpak Sewu - Breakfast
destination_activities.notes: Breakfast at Tumpak Sewu — TWT only, not default for JVTO

destination_activities.name: Kapas Biru
destination_activities.notes: Optional side waterfall near Tumpak Sewu

destination_activities.name: Tumpak Sewu - Ticket (TWT)
destination_activities.notes: Higher ticket rate for TWT channel

destination_activities.name: Madakaripura Ticket
destination_activities.notes: Madakaripura Waterfall park entrance fee

destination_activities.name: Local Guide
destination_activities.notes: Local guide from parking area to waterfall. 1 per group.

destination_activities.name: Papuma Beach
destination_activities.notes: Papuma Beach entrance fee per person

destination_activities.name: Santerra, Goa Pinus, Taman Langit, Apple Garden
destination_activities.notes: Bundled ticket for Batu area attractions. Per person.

destination_activities.name: Jodipan
destination_activities.notes: Jodipan Colorful Village entrance fee per person

destination_activities.name: Taman Langit
destination_activities.notes: Taman Langit sky park viewpoint entrance fee per person

destination_activities.name: House of Sampoerna
destination_activities.notes: Free admission museum. Surabaya is a transit city — no destination_activities entries in DB for JVTO.

destination_activities.name: KRI Pasopati Submarine Museum
destination_activities.notes: Naval museum entry. Manual seed — not in destination_activities DB.

destination_activities.name: Entrance & Tour Fee
destination_activities.notes: Manual seed — not in destination_activities DB. Included for JVTO when this destination is selected.

destination_activities.name: Admission Ticket (Adult)
destination_activities.notes: Manual seed — not in destination_activities DB. Weekday rate, may vary.

activity_starts.label: Bromo Sunrise Start
activity_starts.description: Pickup from hotel at 03:00–03:30 AM. Transfer by private car to Penanjakan I viewpoint area (~1 hour). Arrive before dawn for sunrise viewing.

activity_starts.label: Ijen Midnight Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from hotel/villa at 00:00–00:30. Drive ~1.5 hours to Paltuding basecamp. Register, rent gas masks if needed, begin ascent by 02:00 AM.

activity_starts.label: Bromo Mid-Morning Start
activity_starts.description: Pickup from hotel at 06:00 AM. Drive to Sea of Sand jeep station. Transfer by private jeep to crater rim area. Morning exploration at Bromo.

activity_starts.label: Madakaripura Morning Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Probolinggo hotel at 08:00 AM. Drive ~45 minutes to Madakaripura parking area. Begin jungle trail to waterfall (~30 min walk).

activity_starts.label: Tumpak Sewu Morning Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Lumajang/Artha Cottage at 07:00 AM. Drive ~30 minutes to Tumpak Sewu viewpoint. Begin guided descent to waterfall base (~45 min).

activity_starts.label: Papuma Afternoon Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Jember hotel at 14:00. Drive ~1 hour to Papuma Beach. Arrive for sunset viewing and beach exploration until 18:00.

activity_starts.label: Surabaya City Tour Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Surabaya hotel at 08:30 AM. Begin city tour covering House of Sampoerna, Tugu Pahlawan, Submarine Museum, and Ampel Mosque.

activity_starts.label: Malang City Tour Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Malang hotel at 08:00 AM. City tour to Jodipan Colorful Village, Batu town area, Alun-alun, and local culinary stops.

activity_starts.label: Taman Safari Morning Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Surabaya/Malang hotel at 08:00 AM. Drive ~1.5 hours to Taman Safari Prigen. Entry at opening (09:00). Safari drive followed by Baby Zoo.

activity_starts.label: Coffee Technopark Morning Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Bondowoso/Jember hotel at 08:30 AM. Drive to Coffee & Cocoa Science Technopark. Guided plantation tour and tasting session.

activity_starts.label: Bromo Afternoon Check-In
activity_starts.description: Arrive at Bromo area hotel/villa from Surabaya or Malang. Check-in, rest, prepare gear for early morning Bromo sunrise tour next day.

activity_starts.label: Ijen Pre-Trek Check-In
activity_starts.description: Arrive at Banyuwangi/Bondowoso area hotel/villa. Check-in early evening. Set alarm for midnight departure to Ijen. Prepare trekking gear.

activity_starts.label: Malang Arrival Start
activity_starts.description: Arrive in Malang city from previous destination. Transfer to city hotel. Optional afternoon visit to Batu town or rest.

activity_starts.label: Surabaya Arrival Start
activity_starts.description: Arrive in Surabaya from previous destination. Transfer to city hotel. Optional evening visit to Suramadu Bridge or Kenjeran Beach.

activity_starts.label: Tumpak Sewu via Lumajang
activity_starts.description: Depart Malang hotel early AM. Drive ~2.5 hours to Pronojiwo, Lumajang. Check in at Artha Cottage or proceed directly to Tumpak Sewu trailhead.

activity_starts.label: Madakaripura via Probolinggo
activity_starts.description: Depart Bromo hotel at 06:30 AM (post-sunrise). Drive ~1 hour to Madakaripura parking. Complete waterfall trek then continue to next destination.

activity_starts.label: Papuma Morning Start
activity_starts.description: Depart from Jember hotel at 08:00 AM. Drive ~1 hour to Papuma Beach. Morning beach exploration and cliff walks until early afternoon.

activity_starts.label: Ijen Post-Sunrise Start
activity_starts.description: Return to hotel after Ijen trek (~08:00–09:00 AM). Breakfast and shower. Depart to next destination after rest (10:00–11:00 AM).

activity_starts.label: Bromo Post-Sunrise Continue
activity_starts.description: Return from Bromo viewpoint/crater. Breakfast at hotel. Check-out and continue to next destination (Ijen, Malang, or Surabaya) by 09:00–10:00 AM.

activity_starts.label: Surabaya Departure Day
activity_starts.description: Morning free time or short city activity. Proceed to Juanda Airport or Surabaya train station for departure. Estimated airport arrival 2–3 hours before flight.

activity_ends.label: Hotel Check-In
activity_ends.description: Arrive at hotel. Assist with check-in. Guide briefs for next-day activities. Evening free.

activity_ends.label: Airport Drop-Off
activity_ends.description: Transfer to Juanda International Airport (SUB). Drop-off at departure terminal. Tour ends.

activity_ends.label: Train Station Drop-Off
activity_ends.description: Transfer to Surabaya Gubeng or Malang Kotabaru station. Tour ends upon arrival at station.

activity_ends.label: Return to Hotel
activity_ends.description: Return to accommodation after day activity. Evening at leisure.

activity_ends.label: Free Afternoon
activity_ends.description: Arrive back at hotel after morning activities. Afternoon free for personal exploration or rest.

activity_ends.label: Dinner at Restaurant
activity_ends.description: Transfer to local restaurant for dinner (included if hotel has restaurant package, or separate). Return to hotel after dinner.

activity_ends.label: Overnight at Bromo
activity_ends.description: Settle at Bromo area accommodation. Briefing for 03:00 AM sunrise call. Early sleep recommended.

activity_ends.label: Overnight at Banyuwangi/Bondowoso
activity_ends.description: Arrive at Ijen-area hotel/villa. Check-in. Set alarm for midnight departure to Ijen. Gear preparation.

activity_ends.label: Continue to Malang
activity_ends.description: Depart from current destination. Drive to Malang (~2–4 hours depending on origin). Check-in at Malang hotel.

activity_ends.label: Continue to Surabaya
activity_ends.description: Depart from current destination. Drive to Surabaya (~2–4 hours). Check-in at Surabaya hotel or airport transfer.

activity_ends.label: Continue to Bondowoso
activity_ends.description: Depart from Bromo area. Drive ~2.5 hours to Bondowoso. Check-in for Ijen preparation night.

activity_ends.label: Continue to Banyuwangi
activity_ends.description: Depart from Bondowoso or Jember. Drive ~2 hours to Banyuwangi. Check-in at Ijen-access hotel.

activity_ends.label: Continue to Jember
activity_ends.description: Arrive in Jember. Check-in at Jember hotel (Doho Homestay / Kertanegara). Rest before Papuma or Tumpak Sewu.

activity_ends.label: Bali Ferry Transfer
activity_ends.description: Drive to Ketapang port, Banyuwangi. Board ferry to Gilimanuk, Bali. Continue by land to Bali destination.
